known.section: Steps, row 4 path_detector (line 27); Research, machinePathCitations bullet (line 14)
known.summary: step 4 widens machine-path detection to a fixed list of ten Unix roots, so absolute machine paths under other roots (for example /usr/local/x or /workspace/x) still pass, which misses the Goal and the contract's ban on any absolute machine path; detection must treat every POSIX absolute path as a machine path
